instruction.name: vsetnez.v
instruction.description: Set FCC based on vector elements.

experiments.name: dependency chain through FCC
experiments.notes: The chain closes through movcf2gr (3 cycles) and vreplgr2vr.d (1 cycle), so 4 cycles of closure are subtracted. Measured with the slope method (--unroll 1000 --unroll2 4000) on 2026-11-17.

latencies.notes: vsetnez.v reads the whole vector and produces FCC in 2 cycles; the move back to a vector register is what makes the chain measurable.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsetnez.v $fcc0, $vr8; vsetnez.v $fcc1, $vr9; vsetnez.v $fcc2, $vr10; vsetnez.v $fcc3, $vr11; vsetnez.v $fcc4, $vr12; vsetnez.v $fcc5, $vr13; vsetnez.v $fcc6, $vr14; vsetnez.v $fcc7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vsetnez.v $fcc0, $vr8; vsetnez.v $fcc1, $vr9; vsetnez.v $fcc2, $vr10; vsetnez.v $fcc3, $vr11; vsetnez.v $fcc4, $vr12; vsetnez.v $fcc5, $vr13; vsetnez.v $fcc6, $vr14; vsetnez.v $fcc7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 4.03 cycles. The measured CPI 0.5038 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: vsetnez.v latency to FCC is 2 cycles, measured by closing the loop through movcf2gr and vreplgr2vr.d (round trip 6.00 cycles minus 4).
